notes.title: Dashwalk Duelings Private Beta is on its Way!
notes.content:
Dashwalk Dueling is running a private Beta test for technical FGC players interested in Dashwalk Duelings mechanics and giving feedback on the game's current state.

[url=https://forms.gle/ifffHLQQnW5GmUuL8][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41456006/c40daeb7ca3965be383bde648bbdbc6611f61a64.gif[/img][/url]

The Labrat Beta will feature:
- Training mode
- Offline versus mode
- In-game bug-reporting and feedback
- Regular Updates focused on training mode improvements and player feedback

 and is planned to last until the end of the year!

[b][url=https://forms.gle/ifffHLQQnW5GmUuL8]Sign-up here![/url][/b]

and join our [b][url=https://discord.gg/9vVyZhfFn8]Discord[/url][/b] Server!*
